seoTitle: Number Extractor with Sum, Average, Min and Max
metaDescription: Pull every number out of text and get the total, average, smallest and largest. Handles 1,234.56 and 1.234,56. Free and private.
intro: Find every number in a block of text, list them, and get the total, average, smallest and largest. Handles thousands separators and decimal commas.
why:
Numbers buried in notes, receipts or chat logs are tedious to add up. Copying each one into a calculator invites mistakes.

Paste the text and the tool lists every number it finds and sums them exactly, using integer arithmetic so decimals do not drift. Pick the number style: comma thousands with a decimal point, or decimal comma. Negative numbers are supported. Dates and codes are read as numbers too, so scan the list before trusting the sum.
howTo: Read the list and the totals.
Remove lines you do not want and run again.

faq.a: Yes for decimals. The numbers are added as scaled integers, and the average is shown to four places.

faq.q: Why are dates split into numbers?
faq.a: The tool finds digits, not meaning. 2026-03-01 gives 2026, -3 and -1. Remove such parts first.
Symbols are ignored, but mixed currencies are added as plain numbers.
